items.text: Handicraft, handloom and artisan work can become a business when skill is joined to design, pricing, quality control and marketing, and the main risks are low margins, middlemen and uneven demand, which careful pricing and direct channels help reduce.
Income grows when you control design, pricing and the route to customers instead of selling only through middlemen.
Artisan registration, schemes, geographical indication rules and export requirements are set by official bodies and change.
